fml.menu.mods.info.description.civitatum: Race, subrace and sex selection, a character editor, vanilla racial traits and abilities.
race.civitatum.human.name: Human
race.civitatum.human.description: 1.6 to 1.9 blocks tall, skin from pale to dark brown. Almost every adult wears a cord on the wrist, or the pale band it left: sleepers are tied to their beds. Humans live in all four crowns, hold Calver's Wall and sign the Charters. Almost everything Solvein lives by under the Haze was invented by humans: the knot on the wrist, the bell-ringer until dawn, the empty coffin in the attic. The Choir takes them without choosing; in twenty-six years about one in three was lost.
race.civitatum.human.positive: Adaptable: hunger −15%%. One of Many: villager prices −10%%.
race.civitatum.human.ability: Alarm Bell • a bell strikes: allies within 16 m get Speed I for 60 s, sleepers wake, phantoms within 32 m vanish. Once a day.
race.civitatum.elf.name: Elf
race.civitatum.elf.description: A tall people with pointed ears, 1.8 to 2 blocks. Four branches live apart: mapmakers of the sky, night watchers, the cities underground and the old groves. Choose a subrace.
race.civitatum.elf.positive: Choose a subrace to see its traits.
race.civitatum.elf.negative: Choose a subrace to see its traits.
race.civitatum.astral_elf.name: Astral Elf
race.civitatum.astral_elf.description: Tall, 1.8 to 2 blocks, beardless; a gleam in the eyes like a star in a well. They work in the observatories of Chrysea and Laeris as star scribes and sell maps of the sky. They were the first to see that the sky over the rifts reflects no stars. Who looks into a rift too long hears the Choir awake, so old watchers count to a hundred and look away. One who does not, walks one night to where they looked.
race.civitatum.astral_elf.positive: Night Sight: see in the dark. Starlight: you shine yourself, 6 blocks (with LambDynamicLights).
race.civitatum.astral_elf.ability: Constellation • every creature within 48 m glows through walls for 30 s, the whole party sees them. Once a day.
race.civitatum.dark_elf.name: Dark Elf
race.civitatum.dark_elf.description: Ash-grey skin, hair white from birth, three thin scars on the wrists from the knot. They live in the cities under Ardeyn and Chrysea, where a bell goes deaf. They are saved by the knot: three sleepers are tied together, and if one rises the other two wake. In the wars of the crowns the dark elves took no side.
race.civitatum.dark_elf.positive: Underground: night vision; below y=32 +2 hearts. Neutrality: spiders do not attack first, webs do not hold you.
race.civitatum.dark_elf.ability: Knot • up to three targets within 12 m are rooted for 4 s, then Slowness II for 4 s; cobwebs stay where they stood. Once a day.
race.civitatum.night_elf.name: Night Elf
race.civitatum.night_elf.description: Lilac skin, from pale lilac to dark plum; ears longer than other elves', many wear an ear trumpet after forty. They keep watch at the forest outposts of Laeris where humans sleep. The Choir calls sleepers, so night elves do not sleep at night and pay with their hearing. By day they sleep behind locked doors, with a human and a bell outside.
race.civitatum.night_elf.positive: Nightborn: night vision, no phantoms. Watch: enemies notice you 25%% later.
race.civitatum.night_elf.ability: Shadow • for 60 s mobs lose sight of you; you cannot attack. Once a day.
race.civitatum.wood_elf.name: Wood Elf
race.civitatum.wood_elf.description: A grey band of ash runs across the face from temple to temple, worn instead of a cut cord. They live in the old groves of Calver and the south and, like the firbolgs, burn tainted groves. Wood elves do not sleep but go into a trance, where the Choir is quiet and does not lead away. For twenty-six years they have not told humans.
race.civitatum.wood_elf.positive: Hunter: animals drop +1 meat and +1 hide. Herbalist: plants drop 25%% more.
race.civitatum.wood_elf.ability: Trance • hold the key up to 10 s: you cannot move, damage taken +50%%. Then Regeneration II 10 s, the undead ignore you 60 s, your respawn point is set here. Released early: Regeneration I 5 s. Once a day.
race.civitatum.dwarf.name: Dwarf
race.civitatum.dwarf.description: Short and broad, 1.2 to 1.5 blocks; men and women both wear beards. The halls under the mountains of Ardeyn and Calver and the forges of the Guild of Workshops: almost every bell of Solvein was cast by dwarves. A bell goes deaf in a cave, so spent mines are sealed with chains and the bell hangs outside. A dwarf going down a mine at night goes where no one can hear.
race.civitatum.dwarf.positive: Mountain Sight: night vision. Smith: anvil costs 25%% less, your own tools and armour have +10%% durability.
race.civitatum.dwarf.ability: Seal • a chain on a block: for 10 min no hostile mob appears in a 9×9×9 zone. Once a day.
race.civitatum.orc.name: Orc
race.civitatum.orc.description: Human height, heavier in the shoulders; skin from light olive to marsh green, scars shown openly. The foothill clans between Ardeyn and Calver: the crowns call them when someone must stand in the first row. Orcs were the first to face the Haze with weapons and the first to learn weapons do not help. An orc is buried with a weapon, the only coffin in Solvein that is never empty.
race.civitatum.orc.positive: Sturdy Body: +2 hearts. Warrior's Honour: piglins wait while no weapon is in your hand.
race.civitatum.orc.ability: Berserk • Rage for 30 s: +50%% damage, Haste II, no knockback. Then Comedown: Hunger III for 30 s. Once a day.
race.civitatum.dragonborn.name: Dragonkin
race.civitatum.dragonborn.description: A scaled, horned people, 1.6 to 1.9 blocks. Blood of four elements: fire, frost, storm and the Edge. Choose a subrace.
race.civitatum.dragonborn.positive: Choose a subrace to see its traits.
race.civitatum.dragonborn.negative: Choose a subrace to see its traits.
race.civitatum.fire_dragonborn.name: Fire Dragonkin
race.civitatum.fire_dragonborn.descripti: Golden, copper or bronze scales, a hoarse voice even in the young. They live by dragon clans in the hot foothills of Chrysea. Fire breath burns away patches of the Haze, and they are hired like a fire brigade. After three breaths comes the rasp and a day without a voice. The haze is burnt, and the earth beneath is still red.
race.civitatum.fire_dragonborn.positive: Fireproof: fire and lava −75%%. Heat: furnaces within 8 m work 1.25 times faster, fuel lasts 15%% longer.
race.civitatum.fire_dragonborn.ability: Exhale • hold the key up to 3 s: a 6 m cone of fire, damage and burning every 0.5 s, half speed while breathing. Then Rasp: Weakness I for 30 s. Once a day.
race.civitatum.frost_dragonborn.name: Frost Dragonkin
race.civitatum.frost_dragonborn.descript: Silver, pale blue or deep blue scales; the skin is cold even by a fire. The icy coast and mountains of Ardeyn. Frost breath freezes the Haze into vials, and the alchemists of Chrysea pay for each. For a vial they go into the thick of the haze.
race.civitatum.frost_dragonborn.positive: Cold Blood: no freezing, powder snow holds you. Alchemist: potions you brew last 25%% longer.
race.civitatum.frost_dragonborn.ability: Rime • a 5×5 zone up to 8 m turns to ice for 5 s: enemies are rooted, water freezes. Once a day.
race.civitatum.storm_dragonborn.name: Storm Dragonkin
race.civitatum.storm_dragonborn.descript: Amethyst and violet scales; after a storm the hair stands on end until morning. In the ports of Laeris a storm dragonkin is set on a tower like a bell-ringer: a storm over a rift scatters the haze for half an hour. After a night of lightning the head hums for a week. The port pays for the night; the week stays with the dragonkin.
race.civitatum.storm_dragonborn.positive: Lightning Rod: lightning does not hurt you, +10%% speed in a thunderstorm. Sailor: swimming +25%%, air +30 s.
race.civitatum.storm_dragonborn.ability: Lightning • a bolt from the sky at a point up to 12 m: sets fire and strikes the area. Once a day.
race.civitatum.end_dragonborn.name: Edge Dragonkin
race.civitatum.end_dragonborn.descriptio: Black scales, eyes wholly violet without whites; a long gaze, and people look away first. They lived in Solvein long before the Haze and hold no lands. They never sleep and hear the Choir awake every night; none of them remembers life before the Haze. Where they breathe the haze lingers, so they are not let into villages after sunset.
race.civitatum.end_dragonborn.positive: Void Skin: endermen do not attack. Edge Hearing: endermen and shulkers within 32 m are seen through walls, by you only.
race.civitatum.end_dragonborn.negative: In water Slowness I and no Step.
race.civitatum.end_dragonborn.ability: Step • teleport up to 16 m along your gaze, no fall damage for 5 s. Once a day.
race.civitatum.firbolg.name: Firbolg
race.civitatum.firbolg.description: The largest of the forest peoples, 1.9 to 2.2 blocks; blue-green, grey or lilac skin, like bark under moss. Grey smears of ash on the shoulders that never wash out. Firbolgs burn tainted groves themselves and mourn a grove like a person. Who burnt a grove burnt the home of their grandfathers.
race.civitatum.firbolg.positive: Big Body: +2 hearts. Forest Step: leaves and vines do not hold you, saplings within 16 m grow twice as fast.
race.civitatum.firbolg.ability: Roots • a 7×7 zone up to 8 m: enemies are rooted 5 s, then Slowness II 5 s; a wall of roots stands 10 s. Once a day.
race.civitatum.goblin.name: Goblin
race.civitatum.goblin.description: The smallest people of Solvein, 0.9 to 1.2 blocks; long fingers burnt by soldering. The cellars of Laeris and the Guild's workshops in Calver. Goblins invented the clockwork bell that rings all night without a ringer. When grain goes missing in Laeris, the goblin cellar is searched first.
race.civitatum.goblin.positive: Nimble Fingers: falling −50%%. Workshop: anvil costs 25%% less, crafting has a 25%% chance to return one ingredient.
race.civitatum.goblin.negative: Villagers charge 15%% more: they do not trust you.
race.civitatum.goblin.ability: Clockwork Bell • a bell for 60 s: enemies within 16 m weaken, slow down and lose you; no phantoms. Once a day.
race.civitatum.forged.name: Mechanist
race.civitatum.forged.description: Human height; part of the body replaced with brass, copper and dark steel, many have glass eyes. The Titans' ruins under Calver and southern Chrysea, the Guild's workshops. The Choir does not hear what was replaced, so mechanists replace themselves piece by piece, and each replacement erases some memory. Many carry a notebook of who they are and read it aloud every morning.
race.civitatum.forged.positive: Replaced: no poison, nausea or blindness. Notebook: half of your levels stay after death.
race.civitatum.forged.ability: Replacement • 30 s of Resistance II and Haste II. Then Weakness I for 60 s. Once a day.
race.civitatum.hobbit.name: Hobbit
race.civitatum.hobbit.description: Short, 1.1 to 1.4 blocks; barefoot, the broad foot fits no shoe. The quiet valleys of Calver and the gardens of Chrysea. Hobbits first learnt to bake red grain so it is not bitter, and sell the bread, never the recipe. At night they tie the ankle: that knot is harder to undo in sleep.
race.civitatum.hobbit.positive: Small Folk: hunger −20%%. Kitchen: food gives +1 saturation.
race.civitatum.hobbit.ability: Second Breakfast • full hunger, Regeneration I for 15 s and Absorption of 2 hearts for 60 s. Once a day.
race.civitatum.orthosian.name: Turs
race.civitatum.orthosian.description: The tallest people of Solvein, 2.2 to 2.5 blocks; icy eyes, clan patterns on the skin that tell three generations of ancestors. Tursheim, the snowy north of Ardeyn. The Titans' blood is strongest in the turs, and the machines of the Titans' ruins let their own pass. Each bears an ancestor's name; the turs lost most of all, but Ardeyn forbade counting the fallen.
race.civitatum.orthosian.positive: Titans' Blood: +2 hearts. Footing: you cannot be knocked back.
race.civitatum.orthosian.ability: Ancestor's Name • 30 s of Strength II and Resistance I; every mob within 32 m comes for you. Once a day.
race.civitatum.algnor.name: Borian
race.civitatum.algnor.description: 1.9 to 2.1 blocks; horns, a short deer tail and hooves, no shoes. Borye, the southern forests, now a province of Chrysea. Forest borians hang little bells on their horns; city borians saw their horns off to pass through doors and are called “hornies”. In a forest where the trees ring with bells people sleep calmer than in a town with a belfry.
race.civitatum.algnor.positive: Choose a subrace to see its traits.
race.civitatum.algnor.negative: Choose a subrace to see its traits.
race.civitatum.forest_algnor.name: Forest Borian
race.civitatum.forest_algnor.description: Forest borians wear horns with little bells that ring at every step and every move in sleep. In Borye every tree with a bell counts as a bell-ringer. They tell of the figures of the sky as of clans.
race.civitatum.forest_algnor.positive: Horns: unarmed +2 damage and knockback. Grass: bushes do not hold you, +10%% speed in forests.
race.civitatum.forest_algnor.negative: Helmets give half armour. Cannot wear boots.
race.civitatum.forest_algnor.ability: Ram • a dash up to 8 m: targets are knocked back and stunned for 2 s. Once a day.
race.civitatum.city_algnor.name: City Borian
race.civitatum.city_algnor.description: City borians saw their horns off close to the skull to pass through doors; the cut shows rings like a stump. In the towns of Chrysea they are called “hornies”. A borian who sawed off the horns for a door sawed off the bell too.
race.civitatum.city_algnor.positive: Horns: unarmed +2 damage and knockback. Grass: bushes do not hold you, +10%% speed in forests.
race.civitatum.city_algnor.negative: Helmets give half armour. Cannot wear boots.
race.civitatum.city_algnor.ability: Ram • a dash up to 8 m: targets are knocked back and stunned for 2 s. Once a day.
race.civitatum.jahar.name: Kairi
race.civitatum.jahar.description: White skin, a white iris that glows faintly in the dark; House marks on the skin, black blood. They came from the world of Kair two generations ago and settled in Chrysea; they live by Houses, not families. Spilt blood crumbles into black sand, and fire is deadly to the kairi; only the Mask saves them. The Mask shields from fire and burns out the one who wears it.
race.civitatum.jahar.positive: Sand Flesh: falling −50%%. Bargain: villagers pay you 15%% more emeralds.
race.civitatum.jahar.ability: Mask • 15 s: Strength II, Speed II, immune to fire, damage taken +2. Then Aftermath for 10 s: Slowness II, Hunger IV, Nausea. Once a day.

birthsign.civitatum.none.name: No sign
birthsign.civitatum.none.description: No sign yet. Choose a month or draw a lot: the sign is given to the character for good.
birthsign.civitatum.lot.name: Draw a lot
birthsign.civitatum.lot.description: The month falls by chance when the character is saved. One time in twenty the Serpent falls instead: a night without stars.
birthsign.civitatum.tower.name: Tower
birthsign.civitatum.tower.description: The first month. Called the Wall by the folk. The first tower from which all is seen; who stands on it does not run.
birthsign.civitatum.tower.power_text: Tower Key • opens a door, trapdoor or chest within 5 m, iron and locked ones too. Cooldown 10 min.
birthsign.civitatum.spear.name: Spear
birthsign.civitatum.spear.description: The second month. Called the Sword by the folk. A guardian: it opens the year. The first blow does not come back.
birthsign.civitatum.hearth.name: Hearth
birthsign.civitatum.hearth.description: The third month. Called Ash by the folk. The first fire that did not go out; while it burns, the house stands.
birthsign.civitatum.hearth.effect: Near a burning fire within 8 m +1 HP every 5 s. Price: Slowness I and Weakness I in water.
birthsign.civitatum.hearth.power_text: Kindle • a soul campfire heals allies within 6 m for 20 s. Cooldown 3 min.
birthsign.civitatum.beast.name: Beast
birthsign.civitatum.beast.description: The fourth month. Called the Wolf by the folk. The first beast came out of the forest and looked at a human.
birthsign.civitatum.beast.effect: Animals do not flee, taming works at once, +15%% speed when riding. Price: villagers charge 25%% more.
birthsign.civitatum.beast.power_text: Pack • a spirit wolf for 60 s. Costs 2 hunger. Cooldown 5 min.
birthsign.civitatum.mother.name: Mother
birthsign.civitatum.mother.description: The fifth month. Called Bread by the folk. She feeds all who came, and so goes last.
birthsign.civitatum.mother.effect: Hunger drains half as fast. Price: speed −10%%.
birthsign.civitatum.mother.power_text: Share • allies within 8 m get 6 food and saturation and Regeneration for 4 s; you are left with 2 food. Cooldown 2 min.
birthsign.civitatum.smith.name: Smith
birthsign.civitatum.smith.description: The sixth month. A guardian. He stole fire from the mountain and taught people iron, and the mountain took his name.
birthsign.civitatum.smith.effect: Tools and armour wear half as fast, the anvil costs half.
birthsign.civitatum.merchant.name: Merchant
birthsign.civitatum.merchant.description: The seventh month. Called Salt by the folk. He brings salt and news: salt keeps, news does not.
birthsign.civitatum.merchant.effect: Luck +2, villager prices −20%%. Price: helpful potions last half as long.
birthsign.civitatum.merchant.power_text: Salt Circle • for 30 s the undead cannot come within 8 m. Costs 1 sugar. Cooldown 3 min.
birthsign.civitatum.spinner.name: Spinner
birthsign.civitatum.spinner.description: The eighth month. She spins the thread of days; who holds the thread holds the road.
birthsign.civitatum.spinner.effect: Your lead never snaps and ties any mob but a boss. Price: −2 armour.
birthsign.civitatum.spinner.power_text: Bind • pulls a target within 16 m and binds it for 5 s: it cannot move, strike or use items. Cooldown 90 s.
birthsign.civitatum.messenger.name: Messenger
birthsign.civitatum.messenger.descriptio: The ninth month. A guardian. He runs ahead of the sun and brings news before it happens.
birthsign.civitatum.ancestor.name: Ancestor
birthsign.civitatum.ancestor.description: The tenth month. Called the Coffin by the folk. The first dead remembers the names of all who came before you.
birthsign.civitatum.ancestor.effect: The undead do not attack first until you strike them (except the Wither). Once a day a mortal blow leaves 1 HP and Resistance II for 3 s. Price: −2 hearts.
birthsign.civitatum.shepherd.name: Shepherd
birthsign.civitatum.shepherd.description: The eleventh month. Called the Bell by the folk. She counts the herd at night and does not sleep, so no one walks into the dark.
birthsign.civitatum.shepherd.effect: The undead within 12 m get Weakness I. Price: meat gives half the food and no saturation.
birthsign.civitatum.shepherd.power_text: Roll Call • enemies within 24 m glow and are slowed for 8 s, the undead take 4 damage. Cooldown 90 s.
birthsign.civitatum.wanderer.name: Wanderer
birthsign.civitatum.wanderer.description: The twelfth month. Called the Door by the folk. He walks between worlds and leaves a door ajar behind him.
birthsign.civitatum.wanderer.effect: Falling −50%%, speed +10%%. Price: beds and anchors do not set your respawn point.
birthsign.civitatum.wanderer.power_text: Path • with Shift sets a mark; without it, 10 s standing still and you are at the mark. Costs 1 heart. Once a day.
birthsign.civitatum.serpent.name: Serpent
birthsign.civitatum.serpent.description: A sign without a month. Called the Rift by the folk. Of all the figures only the Serpent looks back. Falls only by lot.
birthsign.civitatum.serpent.effect: Poisoned blood: all healing is half as strong.
birthsign.civitatum.serpent.power_text: Bite • a target within 3 m: 8 damage through armour, Poison 10 s, Weakness 5 s. You take 2 hearts. Cooldown 45 s.
